Subject: Request: CentralHealth combined incentive (discount + credits) — exec approval needed

Hi Laura / Rishi —

Quick background: CentralHealth (closing this quarter) is willing to run a 6-month pilot across 3 internal apps if we can meet a commercial package that combines a steeper-than-standard discount plus platform credits for usage during the pilot. They are an attractive logo: potential $900k ARR after expansion (clinical integrations + enterprise seats) and a reference case for healthcare.

What the customer asked for:
- 40% one-time discount on list-rate for first-year committed capacity (Standard policy caps at 25% for AE-level).
- $50,000 in free platform credits to cover token consumption during pilot (outside our usual trial credit bands).
- 90-day payment terms and expedited security attestation (we've already provided SOC2 docs).

Attachments: CentralHealth_MA_v3.pdf (mutual action plan), pilot-SOW-draft.docx, quote-CentralHealth-2026-08-01.pdf

Why I'm asking for exec approval: the combined economics exceed standard AE & director thresholds (discount + credits). This is time-sensitive — they want a signed agreement by 8/12 to align with their procurement window.

Ask: Can we approve an exception here? If not at the full ask, what is the maximum discount and credits we can offer while preserving acceptable unit economics? I put estimated blended gross margin impact in the attached quote.

Notes: Evelyn — CS will own onboarding and ensure early impact metrics so we can convert after pilot. Abby (CentralHealth) is copied on later threads but wanted to keep this internal first.

Thanks —
Markus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Team —

Thanks for the context and P&L. I'm prepared to approve an exception, but with controls that limit our downside. Approvals below: 

1) Discount: APPROVED at 30% for the first year (not the full 40% requested).
2) Credits: APPROVED $35,000 in platform credits to be applied during the 6-month pilot (attached to the pilot SOW).
3) Commitments: require a signed 12-month commitment to go-live pricing (at standard list rate minus the approved 30% discount) within 30 days after pilot completion, otherwise credits are clawed back pro-rata.
4) Payment terms: 60 days (we will not extend to 90 days).

Marcus — please confirm financial ops readiness to create the credit allocation and the clawback clause (we need language the legal team can bake into the SOW/quote).

Markus — you have permission to present the approved structure to CentralHealth. If they push for the original ask, advise them of the alternative structures Rishi outlined and escalate to me before signing.
